scene.note: One TramCard draws every tram on show from the props App hands it, so no card is copied by hand.

steps.note: A card for one tram needs its number, its name and the year it was built.
Those three values arrive as props, whoever uses the card.
The card shows them, laid out like every other card.
The shed list has three trams, in the order they stand.
App takes each tram from the list.
It hands each one to a TramCard as props.
The shed screen matches the list, with no copied mistakes.
One tram needs a line of its own on its card.
App writes that line between the card's tags.
The card shows it in the box at the bottom.
Sometimes App says a tram is away; most days it says nothing.
The card shows the status it was given, or a default when none came.
Every card in the shed says whether its tram is there.
